profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at PatientPoint®
profile.summary: Passionate Software Engineer with a love for the Web, committed to continuous improvement across Back End and Front End development. I enjoy leveraging AI, LLMs, and modern technologies to build efficient, scalable solutions. Open to fully remote opportunities

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading a team of engineers in developing scalable web and AI-powered solutions to enhance doctor-patient engagement.

Working with a wide range of technologies, including JavaScript, Node.js, Express, React, TypeScript, AWS, Terraform, and LLM platforms and integrations.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Software Infrastructure · Web Development · Cross-browser Compatibility · Technical Staff Management

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Marketplace for NFTs tied to physical products.

Working with Javascript, Nodejs, React, Typescript, Unit-test, Web3, Ethereum, Solidity, Smart Contracts, AWS, Python, Django and more fun stuff.
positions.insights: Skills: web3 · React.js · JavaScript · Smart Contracts · Django

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building solid solutions through reliable code.
Technologies: Node, Javascript, Vue.js, Rails, Unit-test, MySQL, Rest API, Docker

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Client B
I worked as a Lead Developer. Coding solutions using multiple tools like: React, Angular, Nodejs, Docker, AWS, Git, Linux, Unit-test, Integration Tests, PostgreSQL, Rest API.

Client A
I helped this customer mainly optimizing his Software Infrastructure. Working on the Back End with Django, Python and Linux; on the Front End with JavaScript, React and Angular; Oracle 11g for the Database  and analytic tools like New Relic and A/B testing.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: I was part of the Shop Your Way team. I helped building, testing and maintaining modules of the project. I worked mainly with JavaScript, Angular, Bootstrap, Compass, jQuery Mobile, HTML5 and Linux.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I participated in different projects, always working in small teams. In one of the projects I was in charge of developing a GUI and an Rest API in order to connect different technologies and allow users to manipulate their Web Server information. Technologies used: Linux, Django, Python, Nodejs, F5, Javascript,  React, Angular.

positions.title: Web & Mobile Developer
positions.description: I participated in several projects mainly working with Linux, Python, Django, AWS, Android, JavaScript, Angular and GIT. I provided web and mobile solutions to fulfill the software needs as well as support the infrastructure.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I was part of the IT department attending web requests. During that time I was in charge of a project which consisted in building a CMS website used mainly by the media department in order to post  information (galleries, videos, news, notes, etc.) related to the organization. The technologies used were Linux, PHP, JavaScript, Jquery, Backbone, Drupal.

positions.title: Web Developer (cofounder)
positions.description:
I participated in different projects working mainly with Linux, Python, Django, Sql, NoSql, Javascript, jQuery, Angular, Nodejs, Bootstrap and GIT. 

Border Waiting Time [ http://garitacenter.com ]
Web Scrapper that shows the border waiting time between Tijuana and San Diego. SEO friendly and Responsive Design.

Wine Route [ http://www.larutadelvinoensenada.com/ ]
Angular solution built on Google Maps that shows places located along the Wine Route. Hosted in Heroku.

positions.title: Technical Support
positions.description:
Provide Software Support to different Companies located in Tijuana. Help customers with SO, Network, Data Bases, System and Infrastructure needs.

Customers: Lincoln Electric, B&I, Thermal Flex, Magnetic Shot, Hogue Inc, Tacana, Radio Latina.
